items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: caused me to go and study with a guy named Louis Gruenberg while we were at the Black Hawk in Chicago. This was at the Chicago Music College, 1937.

ctx.x: Most of the harmonic things that have come into jazz in the last forty years have come from twentieth century classical music.
Or it could go the other way. I think it's part of the air.

What is involved is not so much a lifting, but a spark, a stimulation. If they were bored with it, they wouldn't listen to it. I think they were stimulated by it, as I was, which caused me to go and study with a guy named Louis Gruenberg while we were at the Black Hawk in Chicago. This was at the Chicago Music College, 1937.
